rules.decision: Restore only a break-owned mute; an existing or subsequently personal mute is not the break to undo.
Scheduled scenes pass onlyIfOn; wake-up does not.
An onlyIfOn plan skips unless isOn() returns true.
Six integer volume steps towards max(start / 3, 4), then power off; retain previous volume subject to later choices.

boundary: Authored JavaScript reductions, not extracted Kotlin, device telemetry, a protocol test or a usability result. Example channels and levels. No real time, network, audio, Android alarms or persistence.
omissions: Ad-break channel return, call handover, persistence and retry logic.
Unknown or unreachable TV states; a plan applying assumes a successful connection.
Sleep cancellation, real volume readback, service-start failure and conditional later restoration.
